items: Dr Virendra Kumar chaired 5th National Council for Senior Citizens meeting; launched e-book **'SNEHA'** (Stories of Nurturing, Engagement, Happiness and Active Ageing).
**JEEVAN App** (Joint Elderly Empowerment & Virtual Assistance Network) — unified access to welfare schemes.
**SHATAYU** (Senior Holistic Care Assistance & Training for Your Utility) — digital platform for trained geriatric caregivers ("Ageing at Place" principle).

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → JEEVAN (scheme access) vs SHATAYU (caregiver services) — easy to mix up.
